name: 94939 · Larkspur, CA
findings: ZIP 94939 (Larkspur) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94939 (Larkspur) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94939 (Larkspur) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
